notes.title: Windows Mixed Reality support
notes.content:
Hello VR players !

Jupiteration works with the new Microsoft Windows Mixed Reality headsets.

They are on the cheap side and provide a lot of fun for your buck.
It is hard to admit that even though Jupiteration was designed for HTC Vive and Oculus Rift it looks stunning on the new WMR headsets which cost lot less than competition.

notes.title: Update v1.05 released
notes.content:
Hi gamers,

This update has just few changes but important ones.

1) the game was updated in order to accommodate players with less capable graphics hardware thanks to performance tweaks.

2) the lighting and shadows quality was improved in each level

3) animation performance issues resolved benefiting from the leatest engine paches

notes.title: Update v1.04 released
notes.content:
Hi VR gamers, 

1) after reviewing some feedback and statistics, the difficulty was adjusted.
Now it will be a bit more easy to progress thru the levels.

2) Wave count/progress is now displayed on shield display.

3) all levels will have the same amounts of waves (6) where the 7th wave will be the boss fight.

Enjoy !

notes.title: Update v1.02 released (Oculus Touch support)
notes.content:
Hi gamers,

We care about the VR community and since it is comprised mainly of Vive and Oculus users (those that can use hands in VR), the game has to support both headsets.
Thus the support of the Oculus Rift headset and Touch controllers was added to the game.

Enjoy !

notes.title: Game release
notes.content:
Hi all VR enthusiasts,

the game was released at scheduled time and with discount of 20% !

In next few days we will update you about the progress of Oculus Rift & Touch integration.

We hope that you will enjoy the game having fun !

notes.title: Release date
notes.content:
Hi fellow gamers,

I am happy to announce that our release schedule is on track.
The game will be released 10.Mar.2017 @ 17:00 CET ! (9:00am PST)

Also I'd like to announce that Oculus touch version will be released shotly within few days after initial release just for HTC Vive.
